stem: The Fourteen Points reflected President Woodrow Wilson's belief that —

options.label: A
options.text: intervention in the affairs of other nations was never justifiable

options.label: B
options.text: travel among nations should be regulated by an international organization

options.label: C
options.text: no country should be allowed to spend more on defense than any other country

options.label: D
options.text: cooperation among international leaders was essential to maintaining world peace
